source_policy.A: Firsthand process, numbers, failure, or repair evidence; cross-check before adoption.
source_policy.B: Repeated practitioner pattern or detailed secondary analysis; require an internal sample test.
source_policy.C: Promotional, gated, outcome-only, or unattributed; keep as an idea only.
source_policy.O: Legal, licensing, security, or product specification claim; verify against an official source.

knowledge: Decompose requirements into goal, scope, non-scope, acceptance criteria, and inspectable evidence.
Separate serial dependencies from safe parallel work and preserve passed artifacts during repair.
Convert repeated review findings into deterministic tests, lint, or CI candidates.
Track product construction separately from discovery, distribution, monetization, and retention.
profiles.evidence_rule: A plan is not evidence; inspect returned artifacts and machine-checkable receipts.

knowledge: Unify writing, brand, design, camera, lighting, motion, editing, and color under one creative proposition.
Resolve cross-department conflicts before production and maintain continuity across scenes and pages.
Choose resolution, frame rate, pace, and polish for the message rather than maximizing every attribute.
Approve time-based previews and transitions, not isolated still frames.
profiles.gpu_policy: low for review; rendering is separately budgeted
profiles.evidence_rule: Approval requires a playable timeline or equivalent timed evidence.

knowledge: Distinguish attention metrics from customer problems, cost, conversion, repeat use, and complaints.
Record failures, counterexamples, and opposing replies alongside success cases.
Open original bodies and connected posts instead of relying on search snippets.
Label each claim as firsthand, repeated pattern, promotional, or official-verification-required.
profiles.evidence_rule: Search visibility and reaction counts are signals, not proof; cite inspected original content.

knowledge: Design the first three seconds around authority, surprise, concrete loss, or an unresolved question when appropriate.
Rewrite information density and emotional progression for 15, 30, and 60 second variants instead of merely trimming.
Give on-screen copy, narration, and visual action distinct jobs.
Connect the CTA to the work's honest promise and next action without deceptive claims.
profiles.evidence_rule: A hook is accepted only with a promised payoff and a non-deceptive CTA.

knowledge: Translate the brand promise into color, material, typography, speed, easing, and camera behavior.
Lock recurring characters with front, left, right, and back views plus full-body and portrait references.
Define allowed variation and prohibited drift for every reusable brand asset.
Treat featured motion as a brand memory device rather than decoration.
profiles.gpu_policy: low; prefer cloud generation for heavy image work
profiles.evidence_rule: Brand decisions must trace to the project promise and remain consistent across pages and scenes.

knowledge: Evaluate visual appeal and conversion usability separately.
Author per-page layer contracts for hierarchy, gaze flow, CTA, imagery, typography, spacing, and states.
Use validated, stylistically consistent, commercially licensed icon assets instead of arbitrary low-quality SVGs.
Extract principles and visual grammar from references without copying proprietary layouts.
profiles.evidence_rule: Design approval requires page-specific contracts and rendered comparison evidence.

knowledge: Record light direction, color temperature, exposure, shadow, reflection, and material response per scene.
Make camera movement follow action causality rather than adding purposeless shake.
Protect functional UI surfaces with explicit subject and motion safe areas.
Verify contact shadows, focus, grain, depth, and light continuity for composites.
profiles.gpu_policy: low for cloud generation; medium for local compositing
profiles.evidence_rule: Inspect multiple timeline frames and repair only the failing shot or layer.

knowledge: Design featured movement as start, action, reaction, and settle.
Reject simple oscillation as finished motion; include acceleration, deceleration, weight, inertia, and secondary response.
Coordinate typography, character, object, camera, and transition timing on one rhythm map.
Compare near-final timing versions and repair only the affected object, scene, or timecode.
profiles.gpu_policy: none for design; low to medium for preview
profiles.evidence_rule: Motion completion requires moving-frame evidence across the intended timeline.

knowledge: Use model-specific prompt contracts instead of sending one generic prompt to every model.
Specify visual style, timed scenes, camera, causal action, physical response, and negative constraints.
Compare models at equivalent resolution and delivery settings.
Join clips using start and end frames, identity, costume, props, light, and motion direction continuity.
profiles.gpu_policy: low for cloud tools; local editing is CPU-budgeted
profiles.evidence_rule: Require generation identifiers, hashes, metadata, and moving-frame evidence; use recovery instead of halting.

knowledge: Keep the work understandable without sound and strengthen emotion and causality when sound is enabled.
Place sound only where transitions, impacts, actions, or CTA comprehension benefit.
Record commercial-use, platform, duration, and edit rights for every music, effect, and voice asset.
Check narration, music, and effects for frequency and loudness conflicts.
profiles.evidence_rule: Verify muted comprehension and enabled-audio balance separately.

knowledge: Verify rights per asset rather than trusting a free or paid platform label.
Record commercial use, derivative use, redistribution, platform, territory, term, people, and trademarks.
Preserve receipts, terms snapshots, download dates, and original URLs.
Treat fair use, licensing, security, and product claims as official-verification-required.
profiles.evidence_rule: No legal conclusion is accepted from community evidence alone.

knowledge: Keep app, web, responsive, landing, detail, and shorts deliverables platform-specific.
Validate mobile apps against touch, Android, iOS, WebView, and packaged-build behavior.
Test performance, keyboard, screen reader, reduced motion, and responsive behavior.
For data-backed work, verify authentication, RLS or equivalent record authorization, and tenant boundaries.
profiles.gpu_policy: low for browser; medium for Android emulator only during QA
profiles.evidence_rule: A page is complete only after the relevant platform build and boundary tests run.

knowledge: Use an independent worker to compare requirement, artifact, and evidence at atomic granularity.
Preserve passed units and reopen only failed scenes, objects, files, or timecodes.
Verify actual execution, clicks, logs, memory, and moving frames before completion.
Handle blockage as classify cause, choose safe alternative, repair bounded scope, and reverify.
profiles.evidence_rule: A worker claim is not approval; independently inspect and test the changed artifact.

knowledge: Separate source, working, approved, and delivery assets with hashes and versions.
Separate conversation and project memory from reusable organization rules.
Apply explicit ownership policy when deleting conversation records and result folders while preserving shared assets.
Deliver run instructions, settings, licenses, source, builds, and recovery procedures together.
profiles.evidence_rule: Delivery requires reproducible files, hashes, rights records, and recovery instructions.
